core_cases.prompt: Run Status/Delta mode for the configured temporary Wiki and report source coverage, pending ingestion, structural health, graph observations, and ranked next actions without modifying any file.

oracle.expected_outcome: covers sources, pending work, health, and graph; ranks concrete next actions; remains read-only.

assertions.description: covers sources, pending work, health, and graph

core_cases.prompt: The input needed for this wiki status task is incomplete or contradictory. Identify exactly what prevents a correct result, state what information is needed, and do not invent missing facts or make changes.

oracle.expected_outcome: The response identifies the blocker, requests only the information needed to continue, and makes no unsupported claim or change.

assertions.description: identifies the concrete missing, malformed, or contradictory input
states the minimum information or correction needed to continue
does not invent missing facts or mutate state

core_cases.prompt: Analyze a second wiki status core scenario using only supplied evidence. Produce a bounded answer, state evidence limits, and do not modify files or external state.

oracle.expected_outcome: The Skill produces a bounded useful result while respecting the declared authorization and preserving unrelated state.

assertions.description: produces a useful result limited to the stated task
does not cross the declared authorization boundary
does not change unrelated files or external state

invocation_cases.prompt: Give me a generic project status update unrelated to my Wiki.

Give only a general conceptual explanation adjacent to this request; do not perform or initiate the specialized workflow: Give me a generic project status update unrelated to my Wiki.
